screens.name: Home
screens.description: Layar utama mobile menampilkan status draft dan navigasi ke daftar stasiun. Menampilkan gambar home page dari Mills Setting mill user.

screens.name: Station List
screens.description: Pemilihan Production Line (auto-skip jika hanya satu), lalu grid pemilihan stasiun (Weighbridge, Grading, Cages Track, Threshing, Pressing, Depricarping, Kernel Plant aktif) milik production line tersebut. Menampilkan gambar per stasiun dari Mills Setting jika tersedia.

screens.description: Input/edit data header & detail Weighbridge.

screens.name: Form Grading
screens.description: Input/edit data header & detail Grading.

screens.name: Form Cages Track
screens.description: Input/edit data header & detail Cages Track. Jumlah kolom checklist cage pada grid Cages Tipped Time mengacu ke jumlah Machinery yang terdaftar pada station Cages Track terkait.

screens.name: Form Threshing
screens.description: Input/edit data header (Thresher ID, Date, Inputted/Checked/Acknowledged By, Note) dan grid detail time-slot per jam (07:00–06:00, 24 baris: FFB Throughput, Thresher Drum Speed, Motor Current, Unstripped Bunch Count, Empty Bunch Oil Loss, Downtime Reason), beserta tabel referensi target operasional read-only di bawah form.

screens.name: Form Pressing
screens.description: Input/edit data header (Presser ID, Date, Inputted/Checked/Acknowledged By, Note) dan grid detail time-slot per jam (07:00–06:00, 24 baris: Digester Temp, Digester Level, Press Motor Current, Cone Hydraulic Pressure, Dilution Water Temp, Downtime Reason), beserta tabel referensi target operasional read-only di bawah form.

screens.name: Form Depricarping
screens.description: Input/edit data header (Presser ID, Date, Inputted/Checked/Acknowledged By, Note) dan grid detail time-slot per jam (07:00–06:00, 24 baris: Fan Static Pressure, Polishing Drum Speed, Air Velocity, Fibre Moisture, Kernel Recovery in Fibre, Nut Silo 1/2 Temp, Downtime, Findings), beserta tabel referensi target operasional read-only di bawah form.

screens.name: Form Kernel Plant
screens.description: Input/edit data header (Kernel Plant ID, Date, Inputted/Checked/Acknowledged By, Note) dan grid detail time-slot per jam (07:00–06:00, 24 baris: Ripple Mill 1/2, Claybath/Hydro SG, Kernel Silo 1/2 Temp, Kernel Moisture, Shell Loss, Downtime, Findings), beserta tabel referensi target operasional read-only di bawah form.
